Commentary.Commentary: 111 does not look like a target which could trouble the Windies. But you never know... a couple of quick wickets could make things interesting. Stay tuned...
West Indies were simply brilliant. With the exception of Jerome Taylor, everyone did well, with Narine taking 3 wickets and Williams and Brathwaite sharing 2 apiece.

From 58/8, this is a wonderful recovery from Afghanistan. They were in total tatters as the batsmen just kept throwing their wickets away before Rashid Khan and Amir Hamza provided some stability. They were two of only 3 double digits in the entire innings which shows the Afghans' recklessness.

OUT! Caught! Bowled out on the final ball of the innings. A length ball outside off, Hamza swipes way too early and gets a top edge. It is skied up in the air with no distance. Chadwick Walton gets across and takes it calmly. AFGHANISTAN ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 110!

Outside off, punched towards mid off. Hamza has already started to run even before the bowler has bowled. Mid off fires a throw at the bowler's end but misses and almost cleans up the bowler and the non-striker instead.
Full and wide outside off, Amir comes down the track and slices this down to third man. Just a single.
SIX! THUMP! A length ball around off, Hamza just whips this over mid-wicket and it goes all the way! Useful runs these.

FOUR BYES! Poor keeping from Walton. Full and outside off, Hamza swings hard but misses. The ball comes back in a long way, beats the outside edge, then the off stump and then the keeper as well as he is too lazy to bend. The ball deflects off his pads to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Lucky runs. A length ball outside off, Hamza swings hard but gets a thick outside edge which flies past the keeper to the third man fence!
KESRICK WILLIAMS to bowl the final over.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
SHAPOOR ZADRAN is the last man in.
OUT! Simple catch. A short ball outside off, Rashid pulls this nicely but it has gone straight to Sunil Narine at short mid-wicket. End of an entertaining cameo.
Outside off, Rashid swings but misses.
FOUR! Poor bowling. A full toss on the pads, Rashid paddles this past a diving short fine leg for a boundary!
SIX! Goes again! A length ball this time, Rashid stays back a touch and slaps it over long off once more!
SIX! THRASH! Full and outside off, Rashid comes forward and sends it sailing over long off!
Flicks this away for a run. Single off every ball in that over.
On middle and leg, worked through fine leg for a run.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On a good length around middle, worked through square leg for a single. That takes them past their lowest T20I score. It was 72 against Bangladesh during the 2014 T20 in Dhaka.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE to bowl out now.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
A length ball outside off, Rashid slashes but misses.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Outside off, pushed through point for a run.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Around off, punched through cover-point for a quick single.
JEROME TAYLOR is back on.
Comes down the track and drives it towards long off for one. 7 runs from Badree's last and he finishes with figures of 4-0-19-1.
Flicks this away for a run.
Short and outside off, punched through point for a couple.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
SAMUEL BADREE to bowl out.
A short ball, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a run.
Works this down the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.

DROPPED! Not easy again. A short ball outside off, Rashid jumps down the track and goes hard at that one, getting a top edge. The ball spoons in the air and Evin Lewis runs back from backward point, dives but the ball bursts through his hands. A single taken.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
KESRICK WILLIAMS is back on.
Looks to work this to the leg side but misses. Walton tries to take an extraordinary grab by diving forward but there was never any bat involved.

DROPPED! A tough chance though. Full and around off, Hamza lunges to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and rockets past slip. However, the big man, Carlos Brathwaite, dives to his right one-handed. But he is unable to catch it.
AMIR HAMZA walks in at number 10, replacing Najibullah.

OUT! Caught. The woes continue for Afghanistan. This one is pitched around middle and Najibullah goes for the reverse sweep. Manages only a top edge towards point which the keeper runs to his left and takes.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Pushes this towards long on, past the bowler, Narine himself runs after it, Rashid wants the single but the non-striker is not interested.
Full and outside off, Rashid looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
Works it through fine leg for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Around middle, cramps Rashid for room who looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. A quick leg bye taken.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single.
Banged in short, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, tapped to the point zone for a single.
FOUR! Full and on middle, Rashid gets down and sweeps it fine for a rare boundary. 5 runs and 2 wickets from the over, Narine's figures read 3-0-10-2!
Full on middle, Najibullah works it off the inside edge through square leg for a single.
NAJIBULLAH ZADRAN walks in at number 9, replacing Shafiqullah.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Second wicket in the over. Afghanistan are in tatters here. Full and around off, Shafiqullah reaches out to sweep but does not get to the pitch of the ball at all. The ball lobs back off the leading edge and Narine takes it with a hop. All too easy for the Windies.
The batsman goes after a wide one and misses.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
SHAFIQULLAH SHAFIQ walks in at number 8, replacing Shenwari.
OUT! LBW! The off spinner strikes now. This lands outside off, Shenwari stays back to play that but the ball stays low and pings him on his pads. Narine appeals and up goes the umpire's finger.
A yorker around off, dug out back to the bowler.
RASHID KHAN walks in at number 7, replacing Nabi.

OUT! Straight to the man! Catching practice. Short and outside off, angling in, Nabi gives himself room to the leg side and tries to carve it over point but the extra bounce does him in. He ends up slicing it to third man and does so a bit too well. A simple catch for Jerome Taylor. Half the side is back in the hut.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.
Fuller, pushed towards mid on.
On a good length around off, defended towards mid-wicket.
A ripper to finish. Landed outside off, Nabi lunges to defend but the ball spins in, goes past the inside edge, then the pad and then the stumps.
Full and wide outside off, driven wide of cover for a couple.
Landed around off, defended back to the bowler.
Landed just outside off, Nabi looks to defend but is comprehensively beaten.
Short and outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
MOHAMMAD NABI walks in at number 6, replacing Janat.
OUT! Edged and taken! Brathwaite strikes in his opening over. A length ball outside off, Janat swipes hard at that but only gets a thick outside edge to Chadwick Walton behind.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
TOP EDGE, SAFE! A short ball outside off, Shenwari looks to hook but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, the ball does not carry to the man running in from deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
Works this through mid-wicket for a couple.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE to bowl now.
Now a leg spinner outside off, SS looks to push but misses.

That is a beauty. Tossed up outside off, draws the batsman forward to work the ball to the leg side and then making the ball to turn away slightly to beat the outside edge. Walton whips off the bails and appeals for a stumping but not referred upstairs.
Down the leg side, Samiullah goes back and works it through fine leg for a couple. Narine is a bit surprised with that not being signalled a wide.
This one turns in sharply from outside off, worked towards short mid-wicket again.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
SUNIL NARINE comes on to bowl now.
Short ball, pulled away for a run.
The batsman goes after a wide one and misses.
Landed around off, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. They pick up a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
WIDE. Full and slipped down the leg side, Janat misses his flick.
On a good length outside off, Shenwari backs away and guides it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! TAKE THAT! Short and outside off, Janat rocks back and cuts it hard through the covers for a boundary. That ends the POWERPLAY.
Full and around middle and leg, Karim lunges and blocks it towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot. The fielding side is asking the question. Leg bye signalled by the umpire.
Full on middle, Janat looks to flick but the ball goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg. A quick single taken.
Landed around off, watchfully defended. WICKET MAIDEN for Williams!
SAMIULLAH SHENWARI walks in at number 5, replacing Stanikzai.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Another one goes down. A short ball outside off, Stanikzai looks to pull but is beaten by pace. He is hurried into the shot and the ball goes off the toe end of the bat back to the bowler who takes it calmly in his follow-through. This is going pear-shaped for the visiting side.
Landed outside off, chopped towards short third man.
A length ball outside off, AS looks to pull but toe ends it towards mid on.
Down the leg side, Asghar misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. There is another yes-yes, no-no as the ball goes to the leg side but no run out this time.
KARIM JANAT walks in at number 4, replacing Ghani.

OUT! Terrible communication. From both, the batsmen and the fielders. It is a length ball outside off and Stanikzai hopped to guide it towards short third man. He took a step forward but then Ghani keeps on running. It is too late for Stanikzai to say no but there is more to this drama. Jerome Taylor at short third man collects the ball calmly but returns a wild throw which goes way over Williams' head. Ghani charges back with a ray of hope but unfortunately for him, Carlos Brathwaite comes charging in from mid on, collects the throw and returns it to the bowler who makes no mistake.
KESRICK WILLIAMS to bowl now.
Very full on middle, Ghani looks to sweep but misses. There is an LBW shout but in vain. Looked close. 6 runs and a wicket from the over. Badree's figures read 2-0-7-1.
Goes back and works it to the leg side for a run.
EDGED, FOUR! Quicker and shorter outside off, Stanikzai rocks back to cut but gets a thick outside edge which flies past short third man to the fence!
Massive LBW shout first up. Turned down. Landed around middle and leg, drifting in, Stanikzai misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Missing leg comfortably.
ASGHAR STANIKZAI walks in at number 3, replacing Naib.
OUT! BOWLED! Badree gets the breakthrough. Tossed up full, around middle, Naib swings hard across the line but misses and is castled. Is a bit disappointed. Was looking good out there.
Full on middle and off, pushed through to long on for a single.
Full on middle, Gulbadin pushes it straight to short mid-wicket. He misfields but no run is conceded.

FOUR! Ho ho ho! Good aggression from these two! But poor bowling from Taylor. He delivers another half tracker, around off, Naib gives himself room to the leg side and swats it over mid-wicket. Almost goes all the way.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
This is full and on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fine leg is pushed back now. Deep mid-wicket is in place as well.
FOUR! SPANKED! That is some shot. Banged in short outside off, Ghani jumps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes it over cover for a boundary!
On a good length around off, nipping in sharply, with bounce, Ghani looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge towards backward point.
Pushes this towards mid on for a single.
Quicker and shorter outside off, Ghani rocks back and looks to cut but misses.
Fuller and around off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On middle and leg, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
SAMUEL BADREE to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! SMOKED! Naib is signalling his intentions. This is another short ball and Naib rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for consecutive boundaries! 10 from the opening over!
FOUR! Terrific shot! Full on middle, Naib whips this over mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
An inswinging yorker, around middle, GN digs it back to the bowler.
WIDE. Another bouncer, this one is way too high and Gulbadin ducks.
Another short ball, Naib mistimes his pull to mid on.
A short ball, down the leg side, tucks Usman up, but he works this towards fine leg for a single.
A bouncer but slightly down the leg side, Ghani ducks.
Right then. We are ready to go. USMAN GHANI and GULBADIN NAIB will open the innings for Afghanistan. JEROME TAYLOR will start off proceedings to Ghani. Here we go!
A minute's silence is being observed by the players in memory of the victims in the blast that took place in Kabul. The players are wearing black arm bands as well.
TOSS - The news from out in the middle is that AFGHANISTAN HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BAT.

As the world sinks into the frenzy of the Champions Trophy, West Indies get involved into a bilateral series with Afghanistan which may not stir heads but it is an important contest nevertheless. West Indies will aim to win this series without any hiccup but the Afghan side is one which is improving all the time. Hello and a warm welcome to the first T20I between West Indies and Afghanistan at Basseterre.
